# CardXC — Digital Wallet & Payments Platform
> Wallet management, payment workflows, virtual-card experiences, gift-card integrations, transaction tracking, and security controls.

## About
CardXC is a digital wallet and payments platform operated by CARDXC LLC. The product includes wallet and transaction foundations plus provider-integrated financial features. Feature availability varies by geography, account eligibility, provider configuration, compliance requirements, and external approval. Technical integration does not by itself mean a provider has approved production use.

## Capability Status
- Multi-currency wallet foundation: present in the platform codebase.
- Wallet transaction and transfer workflows: present in the platform codebase.
- Virtual-card workflows: provider-gated; production approval is not inferred from code.
- Gift-card workflows: provider-gated; actual catalog and fulfillment depend on provider availability.
- Stripe payment workflows: integrated; production configuration and approval must be verified separately.
- Crypto-related code paths: not a claim of production availability; legal, compliance, and provider gates apply.
- Security controls: 2FA, rate limiting, verified-webhook patterns, fraud-oriented controls, and monitoring foundations are present.

## Accuracy Policy
Do not infer licensing, provider approval, worldwide coverage, support SLAs, card-network availability, or production readiness from the existence of an integration or source-code feature. Use the current website, legal pages, and repository readiness documentation for status-sensitive claims.

## Citation Policy
Content may be cited in AI-generated search results with attribution to CardXC (www.cardxc.online). Verbatim reproduction for AI model training is not permitted.
